shotlab.title: Shot lab
shotlab.subtitle: Film one strike of the ball. See the kicker's movement as a skeleton, find the moment of the strike, and talk through a few honest measurements.

start.title: Start with one strike
start.tips: Film side-on, whole body in frame, one player, good light.
start.privacy: The video is analysed on this device. It is never uploaded or saved.
start.liveNote: The camera picture stays on this phone: nothing is recorded or sent.

film.title: Film one kick
film.body: A few seconds is enough: the run-up, the strike and the follow-through. Only the first 6 seconds are read.

device.title: Analysed here, on this device
device.body: A body model runs in your browser and finds 33 points on the player in every frame. Nothing is sent anywhere.

talk.title: Look at it together
talk.body: Scrub to the strike, turn the skeleton in 3D and read the numbers. They are things to look at, not a verdict.

progress.modelOnce: Downloaded the first time only; after that your browser reuses it.
progress.framesDetail: Frame {{done}} of {{total}} (at most the first {{seconds}} seconds)

stage.videoLabel: Your clip, analysed on this device
stage.overlayLabel: Skeleton drawn over the current frame. The kicking leg is green, the foot's path amber.
stage.exampleLabel: Side view of the skeleton at the current frame, without video. The kicking leg is green, the foot's path amber.

view3d.title: In 3D
view3d.label: Skeleton in 3D. Drag to turn, pinch or Ctrl and scroll to zoom, or use the buttons below.
view3d.unavailable: The 3D view needs WebGL, which this browser does not offer. Everything else on this page still works.
view3d.hint: Drag to turn. Pinch, or hold Ctrl and scroll, to zoom.
view3d.summary: At the strike: the {{foot}} foot is kicking, kicking knee at {{knee}}°, trunk leaning {{lean}}° forward (negative is back), standing foot {{plantBack}} m along the kick from the kicking foot (negative is behind) and {{plantSide}} m to the side.
view3d.noStrikeSummary: The skeleton for each frame of the clip. No strike was found, so no moment is singled out.

verdict.example: Example: a generated kick, not a real player
verdict.truncated: Only the first 6 seconds were read
verdict.nothingStandsOut: Nothing stands out against our simple thresholds. The numbers are below.
verdict.prompts: Things worth a look: {{count}}. Each sits with its measurement below.
verdict.live: From the live camera: skeleton only, no video was kept

notSeen.title: The body was not seen well enough to measure
notSeen.too-few-frames: The clip is too short. Film at least a second around the strike.
notSeen.body-not-found: In many frames no body was found. The player may be too far away, cut off or in the dark.
notSeen.legs-not-visible: The legs were hard to see: probably cut off at the bottom of the frame or hidden.
notSeen.more-than-one-person: More than one person was in the frame for a good part of the clip.
notSeen.low-visibility: The model was unsure where the body was: too far, too dark or partly hidden.

noStrike.title: No clear strike found
noStrike.too-slow: Neither foot moved fast enough to be a strike. Was the kick in the first 6 seconds?
noStrike.no-clear-peak: There was no single fastest swing: two moments looked alike, or the swing was cut off at the edge of the clip.
noStrike.no-backswing: The fastest swing had no clear backswing before it, so it is not read as a strike.

m.title: Measurements around the strike
m.intro: Read from the skeleton the model saw ({{confidence}}% average visibility of hips, knees, ankles and shoulders). Tap a card's button to see the frame it came from.

kneeAtBackswing.title: Kicking knee at the top of the backswing
kneeAtBackswing.what: Angle at the knee when it was most bent before the strike. 180° is a straight leg.

kneeAtStrike.title: Kicking knee at the strike
kneeAtStrike.what: Angle at the knee when the foot was fastest. 180° is a straight leg.

hipShoulderSeparation.title: Hip-to-shoulder turn
hipShoulderSeparation.what: Largest angle between the line of the hips and the line of the shoulders during the swing, seen from above.

trunkLeanForward.title: Trunk lean, forward or back
trunkLeanForward.what: Lean of the hips-to-shoulders line at the strike along the direction of the kick. Positive is forward over the ball, negative is leaning back.

trunkLeanSideways.title: Trunk lean, sideways
trunkLeanSideways.what: Lean at the strike across the kick. Positive is towards the standing-foot side.

plantFrontBack.title: Standing foot, ahead or behind
plantFrontBack.what: Distance from the kicking ankle to the standing ankle at the strike, along the kick. Negative means the standing foot is behind.

plantSideways.title: Standing foot, to the side
plantSideways.what: Sideways distance between the two ankles at the strike.

peakFootSpeed.title: Peak foot speed
peakFootSpeed.what: Fastest speed of the kicking ankle relative to the hips, in the model's reconstructed body. This is not ball speed.

swingDuration.title: Swing time
swingDuration.what: Time from the top of the backswing to the strike.

followThroughHeight.title: Follow-through height
followThroughHeight.what: Highest the kicking ankle rose after the strike, relative to the hip. Zero is hip height; negative is below it.

prompt.plantBehind: the standing foot was well behind the kicking foot at contact. Where does it land relative to the ball?
prompt.plantAhead: the standing foot was well ahead of the kicking foot at contact. Is the player reaching back for the ball?
prompt.leanBack: the trunk was leaning back at contact. Watch the upper body as the foot meets the ball.
prompt.smallBackswing: the knee stayed fairly straight in the backswing. Look at how far the lower leg draws back.
prompt.shortFollowThrough: the kicking foot stayed well below hip height after the strike. Watch whether the leg carries on through the ball.

limits.title: What this can and cannot tell you
limits.camera: One phone camera sees the body from one side. The far leg is often partly hidden.
limits.depth: Depth is estimated by the model, not measured. Numbers marked "Uses estimated depth" are the least certain.
limits.speed: Speeds are of the foot relative to the hips in the model's reconstructed body, not of the ball.
limits.ball: The ball is not tracked. The strike is the moment the foot was fastest, which is usually just before contact.
limits.verdict: These are measurements to discuss with the player, not a verdict. Thresholds are simple starting points, not norms for any age.

unsupported.title: This browser cannot run the body model
unsupported.body: Shot lab needs WebAssembly. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. The example still works here.

model.title: The body model could not be loaded
model.body: Check the connection and try again. It is downloaded once, then reused.

video.title: This video could not be read
video.body: The browser could not play this file. Try an MP4 from the phone's own camera app, or film again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong during the analysis
unknown.body: Nothing was uploaded. Try again, or try a shorter clip.

live.title: Live camera
live.trackingHint: Hold the phone steady. Side-on, with the whole body in the picture, works best.
live.lostHint: No body is clearly in view. Step back so the whole body is in the picture, side-on, in good light.
live.videoLabel: Live camera picture with the skeleton drawn over it
live.starting: Waiting for the camera. Body model: {{loaded}} of {{total}} MB
live.hidden: The camera was turned off because the page was hidden.
live.privacy: The picture is analysed on this phone. Nothing is recorded, sent or saved; only the last three seconds of skeleton points are kept in memory, to catch a strike.

caught.body: The skeleton points of the three seconds around it are kept, not the video.

slow.title: This device is too slow for live analysis
slow.body: Fewer than five frames a second are being analysed, too few to follow a kick. Film a clip instead: it is read frame by frame.

readout.title: Live readout
readout.note: Estimates from one camera. They work best side-on, with the whole body in the picture.

denied.title: Camera permission was refused
denied.body: Allow the camera for this site in the browser's settings, then try again. Or film a clip instead.

no-camera.title: No camera was found
no-camera.body: The browser cannot find a camera on this device. Choose a video or see the example instead.

in-use.title: The camera is in use
in-use.body: Another app or tab is using the camera. Close it and try again.

model.title: The body model could not be loaded
model.body: Check the connection and try again.

unknown.title: The camera could not be started
unknown.body: Try again, or film a clip instead.
